title: Systems, interventions, and evidential scope
topics: A feedback question requires plant, actuator, sensor, target and operating range

Control Atlas methods must not be mistaken for a live Atlas or Bitwork router

title: Continuous and sampled plant dynamics
topics: The exact first-order stable response assumes one real pole and no disturbance
Exact first-order ZOH depends on held-constant input between samples
Continuous-time dynamics and sampled dynamics require an explicit hold convention
Exact model discretization does not identify the actual plant

title: Stability, equilibria, and model boundaries
topics: A scalar discrete pole strictly inside the unit circle is asymptotically stable
Unit-circle boundary is not an asymptotic stability certificate
Linearized local stability need not imply global nonlinear stability
Open-loop stability cannot establish closed-loop safety

title: Feedback, disturbances, and error
topics: Negative feedback regulates a chosen output but may excite dynamics or noise
Setpoint tracking and disturbance rejection are different tests
Integrated absolute error is a metric, not a safety criterion
Sensor noise and high-frequency control action require a separate model

title: State-space reachability and observation
topics: Controllability depends on A and B, not an attractive controller name
Observability depends on A and C, not merely repeated sensor readings

title: Sampling, delays, and ZOH
topics: Nyquist strictly applies to a known bandlimited ideal-sampling signal
Sampling above twice bandwidth is not a controller-stability guarantee

title: PI/PID, saturation, and anti-windup
topics: Integral action can wind up when actuator command exceeds physical limits

title: System identification and uncertainty
topics: Identifiability requires informative excitation and an explicit candidate model
Disturbance and controller action can confound a closed-loop identification
A good fitted response is not physical-model validation
Compare fitted dynamics on holdout inputs and disturbances

title: State estimation and scalar Kalman filtering
topics: A Kalman covariance is conditional on specified process and measurement noises
A scalar linear-Gaussian filter uses prediction, innovation and correction

title: Finite-horizon optimal control and constraints
topics: Finite-horizon scalar LQR uses backward Riccati recursion
Unconstrained LQR ignores actuator saturation and state constraints
Cost-to-go is defined by a user-chosen Q/R weighting, not universal optimality
A low quadratic model cost is not evidence of good production control

title: Robustness, margins, and small gain
topics: Strict small-gain product is sufficient only for stable operator interconnection norms
A failed sufficient small-gain check does not prove real instability
Physical saturation/delay/noise invalidate simplistic gain arguments
Robustness results require uncertainty sets, frequencies and operating domain

title: Verification, industrial safety, and AI knowledge reuse
topics: Controller deployment requires change control and monitored evidence
